rule_statistics.label: typhoid
rule_statistics.description: Matches texts describing a combination of at least one core GI symptom (vomiting, nausea, diarrhea, constipation) and at least one systemic symptom or abdominal pain (fever, headache, abdominal/stomach pain).

examples_true_positive.text: i have developed diarrhea. it is accompanied by severe pain in my belly area. i don't feel like eating anything, and most of the time, i have a mild headache.
i've been experiencing high fever, especially at night. it's been really uncomfortable. there is a mild headache along with constipation and diarrhea.

i've lost a lot of weight in the past week because i haven't been able to eat much due to nausea and vomiting. this is followed by mild fever, headache and belly pain. i'm really concerned about my health.
i have been experiencing diarrhea and have had loose, watery stools several times a day. i have lost my appetite and feel nauseated all the time. i am starting to get a mild fever too.
i've had a persistent stomach pain for the past week, and it is not healing even with medication. i feel like vomiting and can't eat anything, and because of which i have become extremely weak.
the stomach discomfort has been severe and frequent. vomiting and constipation have also happened. i'm concerned about my health.

rule_statistics.label: chicken pox
rule_statistics.description: Identifies explicit mentions of 'red spots', 'patches', or 'rashes' combined with any general systemic symptom or itching, as these are strong indicators not present in counter-examples. Priority increased to resolve conflict with typhoid.

examples_true_positive.text: i am starting to develop tiny red spots all over my face and neck area, and it itches when i touch them. the itching is making my day very uncomfortable.

i am exhausted and have lost my appetite. i feel vomiting and can't eat anything. in addition, little red spots are beginning to appear on my skin and near the neck. i am really worried about my health.
i'm worried about these red spots on my skin. it's spreading rapidly and causing a lot of problems. i also developed a mild fever and headache every night.
there are small red spots all over my body that i can't explain. the bumps are itchy and uncomfortable and seem to spread rapidly. it's worrying me.

rule_statistics.label: psoriasis
rule_statistics.description: Identifies characteristic nail problems like small dents, pits, or strange inflammation, which are strong indicators of psoriatic nail disease.

examples_true_positive.text: the skin around my mouth, nose, and eyes is red and inflamed. it is often itchy and uncomfortable. there is a noticeable inflammation in my nails.
i have experienced difficulty sleeping due to the itching and discomfort caused by the rash. there are small dents in my nails, which is really concerning.
my nails are starting to have small pits on them. i am worried and don't know what is causing it. also, my joints pain and there are rashes on my arms and back.

rule_statistics.label: psoriasis
rule_statistics.description: Captures various descriptions of joint pain, often with strong adjectives (e.g., excruciating, extreme), which is a key symptom of psoriatic arthritis.

examples_true_positive.text: i have noticed a sudden peeling of skin at different parts of my body, mainly arms, legs and back. also, i face severe joint pain and skin rashes.

rule_statistics.label: varicose veins
rule_statistics.description: Matches mentions of cramps specifically located in the legs or calves, including pain similar to cramps.

examples_true_positive.text: i have noticed cramps in my calves are becoming more frequent and intense. it is causing me a lot of discomforts. i am also overweight and my legs have started to swell.
walking is tough for me because of cramps in my calves. obesity, i believe, is the cause of this. after a while of working, i'm exhausted.
